description: Call this before creating a campaign to verify the tenant is ready to send email. Returns: sender domain(s) and their validation status, warm-up phase (cold/warming/warmed), daily send rate cap, throttle settings, and senders: the senders an email campaign can be sent with (identityId, name, From address, default, selectable and the reasons a sender is not selectable) and the default sender (defaultIdentityId). Pass a selectable identityId as sender_identity_id to nevent_create_campaign to send with that sender; omit it to use the default. senders.perCampaign=false means the organization does not choose the sender per campaign: every campaign uses its sender. If the sending profile is not validated or still in warm-up, warn the user before scheduling a large campaign. Combine with nevent_get_suppressions_summary for a full deliverability health check.
name: nevent_get_sending_profile
